description_en: Restores data across regions to an existing instance
description_zh: 该接口用于跨地域恢复数据到已有实例
name: RestoreDdrTable

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the existing instance to be recovered
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination region. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 目标地域ID，可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The restoration method. Valid values:
0: restores data based on a backup set. If you set this parameter to 0, you must also specify the BackupId parameter.
1: restores data to a point in time. If you set this parameter to 1, you must also specify the RestoreTime, SourceRegion, and SourceDBInstanceName parameters.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
恢复方式，取值：
0：基于备份集恢复，还需要传入参数BackupId。
1：基于时间点恢复，还需要传入参数RestoreTime、SourceRegion、SourceDBInstanceName。

默认值：0
parameters.name: restore_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cross-region backup set. You can call the DescribeCrossRegionBackups operation to query the ID.
This parameter is required when RestoreType is set to 0
parameters.help_zh:
跨地域备份集ID。可以通过接口DescribeCrossRegionBackups查询。
RestoreType=0时需要传入此参数
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The point in time to which you want to restore data. The specified point in time must be earlier than the current time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. This parameter is required when RestoreType is set to 1
parameters.help_zh: 恢复时间点恢复的时间，需要早于当前时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 RestoreType=1时需要传入此参数
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the source region for point-in-time restoration.
This parameter is required when RestoreType is set to 1
parameters.help_zh:
基于时间点恢复的来源地域。
RestoreType=1时需要传入此参数
parameters.name: source_region

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the source instance to recover data to a point in time.
This parameter is required when RestoreType is set to 1
parameters.help_zh:
基于时间点恢复的来源实例ID。
RestoreType=1时需要传入此参数
parameters.name: source_db_instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The databases and tables that you want to restore. Format:
```[{"type":"db","name":"<Name of database 1>","newname":"<New name of database 1>","tables":[{"type":"table","name":"<Name of table 1 in database 1>","newname":"<New name of table 1>"},{"type":"table","name":"<Name of table 2 in database 1>","newname":"<New name of table 2>"}]},{"type":"db","name":"<Name of database 2>","newname":"<New name of database 2>","tables":[{"type":"table","name":"<Name of table 3 in database 2>","newname":"<New name of table 3>"},{"type":"table","name":"<Name of table 4 in database 2>","newname":"<New name of table 4>"}]}]```
parameters.help_zh:
指定恢复的库表。格式：
```[{"type":"db","name":"<数据库1名称>","newname":"<新数据库1名称>","tables":[{"type":"table","name":"<数据库1内的表1名称>","newname":"<新的表1名称>"},{"type":"table","name":"<数据库1内的表2名称>","newname":"<新的表2名称>"}]},{"type":"db","name":"<数据库2名称>","newname":"<新数据库2名称>","tables":[{"type":"table","name":"<数据库2内的表3名称>","newname":"<新的表3名称>"},{"type":"table","name":"<数据库2内的表4名称>","newname":"<新的表4名称>"}]}]```
parameters.name: table_meta

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

schema.description_en: The details of the response parameters
